mapper.select: SELECT * FROM problem_event_outbox WHERE dedupe_key = #{dedupeKey} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM problem_event_outbox WHERE dedupe_key = #{dedupeKey} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE problem_event_outbox SET status = 'PENDING', attempts = 0, next_attempt_at = #{now}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = NULL, sent_at = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND dedupe_key = #{dedupeKey} AND event_type = 'JUDGE_DISPATCH' AND status = 'FAILED'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM problem_event_outbox WHERE AND attempts < 20 AND ((status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'SENDING' AND lease_until <= #{now})) ORDER BY next_attempt_at ASC, created_at ASC, event_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE problem_event_outbox SET status = 'SENDING', attempts = attempts + 1, lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, last_error = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND AND attempts < 20 AND ((status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'SENDING' AND lease_until <= #{now}))

UPDATE problem_event_outbox SET status = 'FAILED', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, next_attempt_at = #{now}, last_error = 'LEASE_EXPIRED_AFTER_MAX_ATTEMPTS' WHERE AND status = 'SENDING' AND lease_until <= #{now} AND attempts >= 20 ORDER BY lease_until ASC, event_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM problem_event_outbox WHERE status = 'SENT' AND ((event_type = 'POINTS_AWARDED' AND sent_at < #{pointsBefore}) OR (event_type = 'JUDGE_DISPATCH' AND sent_at < #{judgeBefore})) ORDER BY sent_at ASC, event_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.select: SELECT event_id, event_type FROM problem_event_outbox WHERE event_type NOT IN ( 'POINTS_AWARDED', 'JUDGE_DISPATCH', 'SOLUTION_PUBLISHED', 'SOLUTION_LIKED', 'SOLUTION_COMMENTED', 'COMMENT_REPLIED', 'COMMENT_LIKED', 'SOLUTION_MODERATED', 'COMMENT_MODERATED' ) AND ((status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'SENDING' AND lease_until <= #{now})) ORDER BY next_attempt_at ASC, created_at ASC, event_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
